evidence: Alaska and Horizon use Flyways AI, a technology which leverages artificial intelligence to enable more fuel-efficient flight paths.
We continue to monitor emerging technologies, including artificial intelligence, that may have disruptive impacts which are out of our control.
The continued evolution and increased usage of artificial intelligence technologies may further increase our cybersecurity risks.
ai_positioning.summary: La société utilise l'IA pour améliorer l'efficacité énergétique de ses vols et est consciente des risques potentiels liés à l'évolution de l'IA.
